company_name: Dalian Kaiteli Catalytic Engineering Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides gas purification and catalysis solutions critical for maintaining the purity of gases used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Dalian Kaiteli Catalytic Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in gas purification and catalysis, offering over 30 patented technologies. Their products and services ensure the purity and quality of gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, supporting applications in chemical raw material purification and environmental governance.
